title: Practical Coach added to ARP
details: Practical now includes Learn the Task, Guided Rehearsal and Mock Practical modes
Every course has 12 mapped trade tasks, giving 84 practical tasks across all seven routes
Guided Rehearsal includes safety gates, work stages, camera or gallery checkpoints and recorded quality checks
Mock Practical includes short and full timers, practical questioning, readiness scoring and optional tutor verification
Saved practical progress, results and evidence remain private on the learner's device and work offline
